scope: Actual prototype DATA section executed in Node VM with fake DOM, controlled timers and modal callbacks. Assertions cover document state and target ownership only. No database, real file transfer, MCP, driver, rendering or application-runtime parity is claimed.

tests.name: Object navigation preserves an existing unsaved SQL draft

Reopening the same object reuses its tab and staged changes
Independent documents retain their rows, filters, paging and staged cells
Read-only mode belongs to its object document
Reconfigured connection identity cannot reuse an object tab pinned to the old server
An in-flight query completes into its original console after tab switch
Repeated execution in one console does not duplicate history
Unsupported projection cannot fabricate a successful result for another table
Cancelling one running console cannot cancel a second console
Closing a running console preserves its active operation
Closing a dirty SQL console first offers a decision without deleting it
Closing a clean middle active console chooses its neighbour
Closing an inactive console preserves the active selection
Removed connection rejects a new query while keeping the SQL draft
Changing the endpoint cannot silently redirect a new query
A new unfamiliar connection has no invented catalog or old rows
Background job retains a detached copy of its connection target
Cancelled background job remains cancelled after subsequent progress ticks
A deserialized project reinstalls document ownership without shared snapshots
Execution mode selection runs only the selected SQL fragment
Execution mode selection refuses to run the full file when nothing is selected
SQL statement splitter preserves quoted and nested-comment semicolons
SQL statement splitter retains complete Unicode dollar-quoted routine bodies
Parameter detection ignores quoted literals, identifiers, casts and comments
